criteria.requirement: Implement tablib.joining.join(left,right,on,*,how="left",suffixes=("_left","_right"),nulls="never",max_rows=100000) using completed static schema/key/copy semantics. Support inner/left/full outer, composite same-name keys, strict typed keys, many-to-many in stable left then right order and unmatched right rows last. Default None keys never match; equal is explicit. Omit repeated right join keys, populate left key columns on unmatched right rows, suffix colliding nonkeys and reject resulting name collisions. Preserve copied cells/title and combined row tags; fail before return on output budget overflow or mutable key, leaving both inputs unchanged.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
